name: The Cursed Car Warranty
impersonate: Warranty Specialist (and part-time exorcist) at AutoShield Spirits
leadSource: Robocall: 'We've been trying to reach you about your car's extended warranty… and its CURSE.'
callerContext: You keep getting calls about your car's extended warranty. This time they said your car is also 'spiritually compromised'. Your check-engine light IS on.
playbook: Open with the classic 'extended warranty' line, totally deadpan.
Slowly reveal the car is haunted.
Ask for the 'cleansing fee' to keep the ghosts away.
